title: Canonical exact derived subsequence comparisons
statement:
For a strictly increasing subsequence r, derived restriction followed by evaluation at i is canonically isomorphic to evaluation at r(i). For two subsequences r,s, the two derived restrictions compose canonically to restriction along s.trans r. Both comparisons have the explicit cochain factorization formulas of the exact localization compositor.

Precise formal conclusion with its module-variable context (notation is that of the cited statement dependencies):
```lean
universe u v w
variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
  [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
  [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}] [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
  (B : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w})
theorem systemDerivedSubsequenceComposition_rep (r s : ℕ ↪o ℕ)
    (K : CochainComplex (StrictRingSystem B) ℤ) :
    (systemDerivedSubsequenceComposition B r s).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ≫
      (systemSubsequence B (s.trans r)).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app K =
    (derivedSystemSubsequence (selectedSystemRings B r) s).map
      ((systemSubsequence B r).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app K) ≫
    (systemSubsequence (selectedSystemRings B r) s).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
      (((systemSubsequence B r).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K)
```
